title: SourceDialog
responsibility: Shows a read-only source reader in the shared modal without changing the current address.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.open
inputs.description: It is the boolean forwarded to Modal. SourceContent is mounted only while it is true.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.title
inputs.description: The name interpolated before “· Source code” in the modal title. It is not transformed here.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.files
inputs.description: Callback returning a promise of source file paths for SourceContent. It is supplied only while the dialog is open.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.read
inputs.description: Callback that accepts a source path and returns a promise of its text. It is supplied only while the dialog is open.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.commit
inputs.description: String commit identifier passed to SourceContent while the dialog is open. This component does not validate or transform it.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.onClose
inputs.description: Close callback forwarded to Modal for close requests; SourceDialog does not call it directly.

inputs.name: SourceDialog.empty
inputs.description: Optional no-files message forwarded to SourceContent while the dialog is open. When omitted, its value is undefined.

outputs.name: SourceDialog
outputs.description: Renders Modal with the title “${title} · Source code”, the text variant, and onClose. It renders SourceContent only while open is true.

errors.name: onClose callback error
errors.description: If the forwarded onClose callback throws when invoked by Modal, SourceDialog does not catch the exception.
